x: Seven Miles and third in the Southern Two Miles' Walk. Stan Botwright was third in the Southern Furlong. Many other members gained A.A.A. and Southern Standards, and won honours in County Races.

In the Middlesex Junior Championships, Stan Botwright won the 220 yards in the 17-19 class, and was runner up in the 100 yards. Stan developed into one of our best sprinters, and in 1939 was Club Champion at 100, 220, and 440 yards.

Acting as a track judge at the Ministry of Defence Sports, held at Motspur Park, was former Club sprint champion S.C.Botwright. Just before World War II started Stan was triple champion, holding our 100, 220 and 440 yards titles.
